connectivity_gamma.description: Assumed fraction of honest miners who extend the selfish chain when block heights are equal (0–1). Higher γ means better-connected selfish miner. Default 0 (worst-case for honest miners).

efficiency_w_per_th.description: Assumed ASIC power efficiency in W/TH. Default 20 (representative of modern S21/M60 hardware). Lower = more efficient attackers.

electricity_kwh_usd.description: Assumed electricity cost in $/kWh for 51%-attack cost estimate. Default 0.07.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.136 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Bitcoin mining game theory and systems dynamics in one call. Returns: selfish-mining profitability threshold (Eyal-Sirer), 51%-attack electricity cost estimate, fee-vs-subsidy revenue split, difficulty epoch trajectory (expansion / contraction / neutral), Nash-equilibrium state for honest mining, and current epoch progress. Sourced from mempool.space and CoinGecko — no API key required. Use for miner-incentive analysis, network security assessment, and pre-investment regime detection.

name: btc-game-theory

attack_cost_51pct_per_hour_usd.description: Estimated electricity cost in USD to sustain a 51% attack for one hour.

fee_revenue_btc_day.description: Fee revenue in BTC per day (last ~144 blocks).

fee_subsidy_ratio.description: Ratio of fee revenue to total miner revenue (0–1). Near 0 = subsidy-dependent; near 1 = fee-driven security.

honest_mining_nash_equilibrium.description: True when no known public pool approaches the selfish-mining threshold.

selfish_mining_threshold_pct.description: Minimum pool share (%) needed for selfish mining to be profitable given γ.

subsidy_btc_day.description: Block subsidy in BTC per day.

hash_rate_ehs.description: Current network hash rate in EH/s.

difficulty_loop_state.description: Hash-rate loop: EXPANDING (more miners joining), CONTRACTING (miners leaving), NEUTRAL (<2% change).

difficulty_projected_change_pct.description: Projected difficulty change at next retarget (negative = easing, positive = tightening).

fee_pressure_state.description: Current mempool fee pressure: HIGH >20 sat/vB, MEDIUM 5–20, LOW <5.

security_trend.description: Brief narrative of current security posture.
